sessions.name: Account creation regression fix — update() vs upsert()

features.name: Found via user repro: new account, paid for trial, returned to /personalisation, got bounced back to /onboarding/welcome instead of /main

Root cause: /api/checkout, /api/sync-subscription, and all four Stripe webhook handlers wrote entitlement via .update().eq('id', uid), which silently no-ops (no error, no insert) if the profile row doesn't exist yet — not a middleware bug, middleware correctly reacted to a write that had silently vanished
All four entitlement writers converted from .update() to .upsert({ id, ... }, { onConflict: 'id' }) so the row is created if missing instead of the write disappearing
